test_lxmert_model: test the LxmertModel class with input_ids, visual_feats, and bounding_boxes to verify language_output, vision_output, and pooled_output shapes
test_lxmert_question_answering: test the LxmertForQuestionAnswering class with labels to verify question_answering_score output shape
test_lxmert_pretraining: test the LxmertForPreTraining class with masked_lm_labels, obj_labels, matched_label, and ans to verify prediction_logits output shape
test_attention_outputs: test that LxmertModel, LxmertForPreTraining, and LxmertForQuestionAnswering return correct language_attentions, vision_attentions, and cross_encoder_attentions shapes
test_hidden_states_output: test that LxmertModel variants return correct language_hidden_states and vision_hidden_states shapes when output_hidden_states is enabled
